adjudication.rationale: The diff shows multi-calendar support via `destinationCalendar: DestinationCalendar[]` and multiple `_calendar` references being handled in several places by switching from `find` to `filter` (e.g., `handleCancelBooking` now does `references.filter(...)` for the main deletion path; `EventManager.updateCalendarEvents` now processes `calendarReference` as an array). However, in `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, inside the recurring-event deletion branch, it still does `const bookingRef = updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"));` and deletes only that one reference per updated booking, which would leave additional calendar events orphaned when a booking has multiple `_calendar` references. Similarly, in `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the merge cleanup still uses `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));`, so it would delete only the first old calendar reference when multiple exist (now normal for collective/team cases per this PR).
